name: @klangk/git-credential
description: Git credential helper: browser-side PAT dialog and credential cache

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: GitHub OAuth App client ID for device-flow authentication (no secret needed); shorthand for a KLANGKWS_FEATURE_OAUTH_PROVIDERS entry with host github.com

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: GitLab OAuth application client ID for device-flow authentication (GitLab 17.1+, flow enabled on the app); shorthand for a KLANGKWS_FEATURE_OAUTH_PROVIDERS entry with host gitlab.com

KLANGKWS_FEATURE_OAUTH_PROVIDERS.description: JSON list of OAuth providers: [{host, flow, client_id, token_url, scope, username}]. flow is device_code (default; requires device_code_url) or authorization_code_pkce (requires authorize_url + redirect_uri; PKCE S256 public client, for hosts like Gitea that implement no device flow). Activates the matching flow for any git host (GitLab, Gitea, self-hosted)
